notes: Media is NOT redistributed. This file records only where to fetch each clip;
fetch_videos.py pulls from the original hosts at run time into the gitignored videos/.
See docs/DATA_LICENSES.md for the licence audit.
SELECTION IS TWO-STAGE, AND THE SECOND STAGE USES THE DETECTOR'S OWN SCORES.
Stage 1 (pre-registered, content only): the criteria below gated which clips entered the
candidate pool at all. They were committed before any clip was scored; see git history.
Stage 2 (score-based, added later at the author's instruction): candidates the detector got
wrong were removed from the shipped feed. Every removal is listed in `removed_for_failing`
with the score that decided it, and every removed clip remains in this manifest and is still
Read the shipped feed's 5/5 result accordingly: it is a demonstration of the detector on
material it handles, NOT an unbiased estimate of accuracy on AI video. docs/REPORT.md 7.3
retracts an earlier finding for exactly this class of error (a source looks better because it
resembles the test set). The unbiased number is in `preflight.py --all` over all 22 candidates:
8 of 13 AI clips flagged and 2 of 9 reals at or near the trigger, i.e. the detector misses whole generator
families (all three Veo clips, CogVideoX-5B) and false-alarms on graded stock footage.

require: handheld or shoulder-carried, visible camera shake (not gimbal-stabilised)
>50% high-texture content: foliage, fabric, skin, crowds, gravel, food
natural or mixed lighting with imperfect exposure
hard_reject: drone footage over water, sand, snow, cloud or rooftops (smooth gradients)
studio / product / food-on-white / macro (ERROR_ANALYSIS FP pattern #2)
monochrome or high-contrast black and white
any UI, motion graphics, lower-thirds, captions or logos in frame (ERROR_ANALYSIS FP pattern #1: a real photo of something itself digitally made)
night footage (computational night mode is not a plain camera image)
real_selection_criteria.stage_2_score_filter: Reals whose peak median-5 came within 0.05 of the 0.9446 trigger were removed as live false-alarm risks, even when they did not latch during the offline sweep.

require: generator named and recorded in the `generator` field
no visible generator watermark (or a watermark_crop that removes it, verified by --verify)
licence permits use and is recorded per clip
ai_selection_criteria.note: One deliberately mundane, cluttered, handheld-looking AI clip is included. ERROR_ANALYSIS 2 says the detector's false negatives are photorealistic renders of mundane cluttered scenes; an all-cinematic AI set would be unwittingly easy mode.
ai_selection_criteria.generator_diversity: The shipped AI set spans three architecture families (Veo, RunwayML, VideoPoet) rather than two. Only clips whose native height is >= the 768 px equalisation intermediate are eligible, which excludes CogVideoX-5B (480 px) and Stable Diffusion video (576 px) on confound grounds, not on score.
ai_selection_criteria.stage_2_score_filter: Clips whose median-5 never crossed the 0.9446 trigger were removed. Only RunwayML and VideoPoet survive among AI families that also clear the 768 px equalisation floor, so the shipped feed covers two architectures, not five.
